actions.action: Confirm the existing Supabase Project identity and no-real-user/no-production-data classification, then configure its Staging-only Preview values outside the repository.
actions.whyHuman: This requires access to an external account and secret-bearing environment configuration.
actions.prerequisites: LAUNCH-01 supplies the trusted database and CI commands; do not share any key or connection string in Issues, chat, logs or artifacts.
actions.expectedResult: Preview points only to the verified Staging Project and controlled owner/other-user test accounts can run migration, RLS and browser evidence.
actions.verify: Record only Project classification, environment separation and redacted pass/fail evidence; never record secret values or private identifiers.
actions.dependencyEffect: Enables LAUNCH-03, LAUNCH-04 and LAUNCH-05 runtime verification.
actions.rollback: Remove the Preview environment binding and revoke test accounts; do not delete the Project without a separate operator decision.

actions.action: Select one text Provider, region, data terms and budget, and configure its server-only Staging credential outside the repository.
actions.whyHuman: Provider contract, billing, region and credential creation are external commercial/account decisions.
actions.prerequisites: LAUNCH-01 evidence baseline and a written option matrix with no assumed DeepSeek approval.
actions.expectedResult: One approved provider record and a redacted Staging-only configuration are available for live conformance tests.
actions.verify: Confirm only provider/profile/region/budget metadata and live test outcomes; never expose a credential or raw private content.
actions.dependencyEffect: Enables LAUNCH-06 live transport and LAUNCH-07 coordinator integration.
actions.rollback: Revoke the credential, remove the environment binding and keep the provider feature flag off.

actions.action: Approve retention, deletion, backup, telemetry, privacy, terms and external claim policy after reviewing engineering options.
actions.whyHuman: These values create public, privacy and potentially legal commitments that an engineering agent cannot authorize.
actions.prerequisites: LAUNCH-05 provides the enforceable data lifecycle option matrix and actual storage inventory.
actions.expectedResult: A signed decision record maps every policy statement to an executable schema, job, UI or runbook behavior.
actions.verify: Review the recorded decision and policy-to-runtime matrix without user data or secrets.
actions.dependencyEffect: Enables LAUNCH-15 acceptance, LAUNCH-16 deletion behavior and LAUNCH-17 region/backup configuration.
actions.rollback: Keep the closed beta private and retain the narrower prior claim boundary until a replacement decision is accepted.

actions.action: Create a physically independent Production Supabase Project and Production-only environment configuration after Staging acceptance.
actions.whyHuman: This creates a production external account boundary and secret-bearing configuration.
actions.prerequisites: LAUNCH-13 Staging acceptance and LAUNCH-15 region/retention decisions.
actions.expectedResult: A clean Production Project can replay the accepted migration manifest and isolates users, data, Storage, secrets and redirects from Staging.
actions.verify: Use redacted project metadata, migration hashes and owner/other-user RLS smoke results; do not copy Staging users or data.
actions.rollback: Disconnect Production environment bindings and remove test users; Project deletion requires a separate operator decision.

actions.action: Approve domain/DNS, Production promotion, bounded canary invitations and public claims only after every LAUNCH-18 gate passes.
actions.whyHuman: Production cutover and real-user invitation change public and external state.
actions.prerequisites: LAUNCH-14 through LAUNCH-17 accepted, required checks green, rollback rehearsed and no unresolved P0/P1.
actions.expectedResult: The accepted commit enters a bounded canary with observable budget/SLO and a 72-hour Go/No-Go window.
actions.verify: Review release evidence, domain smoke, rollback trace and LAUNCH-19 observation without credentials or private user content.
actions.dependencyEffect: Enables LAUNCH-19 canary and final closed-beta acceptance.
actions.rollback: Stop invitations, restore the prior deployment alias and disable Provider/Chat/Proposal/Today flags; use additive DB compensation only.
